description: This file contains utility methods for mortgage calculations, including computing monthly payments, total payments, total interest, and formatting currency and percentages. It also includes parsing methods for doubles and integers from strings.

classes.name: MortgageCalculationUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for mortgage-related calculations and formatting.

methods.name: calculateMonthlyPayment
methods.description: Calculates the monthly mortgage payment based on principal, annual interest rate, and loan term.

methods.name: calculateTotalPayment
methods.description: Calculates the total payment over the loan term based on monthly payment.

methods.name: calculateTotalInterest
methods.description: Calculates the total interest paid over the loan period.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double value as a currency string in US locale.

methods.name: formatPercent
methods.description: Formats a double value as a percentage string in US locale.

methods.name: parseDouble
methods.description: Parses a string into an Optional<Double>, returning empty if invalid or non-positive.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses a string into an Optional<Integer>, returning empty if invalid or non-positive.
